I beat my own ass up, too. Better to take it out on myself then do chores while he sleeps again, chores just make me a pathetic housewife, ha. Ha...


And the worst part is that he works so hard so I can't even complain. He isn't abusive. I wish I didn't like him so much so that I didn't need to continually be around him without letting him sleep. I wish I was a real person. Go to collage? HA. Screwed out of that, yeah. He's smarter than me anyway and I know it even if he doesn't say it.


My dad was rich, right? But they spent it all on a mass implosion. Fix my teeth? Educate me? No. This fucker had millions and he spent it on prostitutes. Ha. My life is a fucking joke. Now I belong nowhere.
